The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its blue finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5059574923593.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Stated size: 6 cm. Quantity: 44 pack.
Snowflake detailing adds a winter-themed accent to the festive design.
Glitter finish provides a light-catching textured appearance for visual interest.
Reusable design allows for storage and use across multiple holiday seasons.
Comes in a convenient 44-pack quantity for extensive tree decoration.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Hanger included

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Wood. Quantity: 100 pack.
Pack of 100 reusable wooden ornaments for festive Christmas tree decoration.
Features hanging cord for easy attachment and clear display on branches.
Crafted from wood to add a natural, traditional detail to your holiday display.
Designed for reuse; store carefully between seasons to maintain quality.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: Hanging Cord

5037204490493.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and wood construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Handmade Detail
Handmade detailing contributes to the character of the design. The decorative elements give the product a distinct appearance that can be coordinated with the surrounding arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Woven Texture
The woven construction gives the surface a structured textile pattern. Its visible texture adds detail to the overall appearance.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Wood. Colour: Red. Stated size: 35 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Handmade detailing with a festive Father Christmas motif and snowflake accents.
Crafted from wood with a woven texture for a structured, decorative appearance.
Red finish adds a defined seasonal character to your Christmas display.
Compact 35 cm size creates a focal point without overwhelming surrounding decor.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

5060832775793.sourceDescription:
Bring a serene, frosted touch to your front door with the Arctic Snowdrift Christmas Wreath. Crafted from realistic white PE branches, this wreath captures a soft, icy winter look — perfect for creating a clean, elegant festive display without the mess of flocking.

Pre-lit with 50 warm white LED lights, the Arctic Snowdrift glows gently from within its delicate white branches, while the built-in timer takes the hassle out of daily switching — simply set it once and let it light up automatically each evening.

What's included
1 x Arctic Snowdrift Christmas Wreath

Dimensions
60cm (Diameter)

Good to know
Powered by battery box (3xAA batteries required, not included)
IP44 rated — suitable for sheltered outdoor use (e.g. covered porches, front doors)
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery
Returns accepted within 30 days
Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty

FAQs
Does it need assembly?
No assembly required. Simply unfold the branches to shape the wreath and hang in your chosen spot.

How are the lights powered?
The wreath is battery-operated (batteries required, not included), making it easy to display anywhere without needing a nearby plug socket.

Does it have a timer?
Yes. The built-in timer automatically runs the lights for 8 hours on and 16 hours off each day, so you don't need to switch it on manually.

Can I use it outdoors?
Yes. This wreath is IP44 rated, making it suitable for covered/sheltered outdoor areas such as porches or front doors. It's not recommended for direct exposure to heavy rain.

Is it covered by a warranty?
Yes. It comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

How is it delivered?
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery.
60cm diameter wreath with 176 branch tips for a full, realistic shape
White PE branches for a clean, frosted winter look (no flocking)
Pre-lit with 50 warm white LEDs
Built-in timer: 8 hours on / 16 hours off for automatic daily use
IP44 rated — suitable for covered outdoor areas
Battery-operated (Batteries not included) - display anywhere, no nearby socket needed

Features and use

The decorative form gives the arrangement a clear point of interest. Position it alongside surrounding colours and textures, allowing the shape and proportions to remain visible without crowding the display.

The stated size helps when planning a shelf, tabletop, wall or seasonal arrangement. Compare it with the available space and with neighbouring pieces, especially where the display needs to leave room for everyday access.

The lighted reindeer and sleigh set transforms your outdoor space into a magical winter scene with realistic brown PP rattan detailing. This two-piece decoration features a sturdy powder-coated metal frame that supports the intricate design for lasting durability.

Brighten your holidays with 175 warm white LEDs embedded along the covered outdoor Christmas reindeer set for a glowing effect. Featuring eight versatile lighting modes, you can choose between a steady glow or festive flashing by pressing the adapter button.

The sheltered outdoor reindeer set is built with IP44 light protection and a solid metal frame for reliable weather resistance. A long five-meter power cord provides flexible placement options around your home or garden layout easily. Equipped with a low-voltage design, it offers added safety for use in residential areas without electrical hazards.

Enjoy effortless automated lighting with the convenient daily timer loop that activates for six hours and shuts off after eighteen. Simply turn it on once at dusk, and the decoration will automatically illuminate your home every evening consistently. This feature eliminates the need for manual switching each night, providing a hassle-free festive experience for busy households.

Crafted with weather-resistant PP rattan over a strong frame, this light-up reindeer set offers a classic natural texture without glitter shedding. The mess-free design keeps your yard and other spaces neat and tidy over seasons without requiring frequent cleanup efforts.
Includes a convenient daily timer that automatically switches the lights on for six hours and off for eighteen, ensuring effortless festive illumination every evening without manual intervention.

Constructed with weather-resistant brown PP rattan over a sturdy powder-coated metal frame, providing realistic texture and durability while remaining mess-free without glitter shedding.
Equipped with IP44 light protection and a low-voltage design for safe outdoor use, complemented by a long five-meter power cord for flexible placement around your garden or home.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Stated size: 23 x 20 x 46 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Includes a built-in timer function to automate the operating period for convenient seasonal display management.
Compact footprint of 23 x 20 cm allows it to serve as a versatile focal point in coordinated festive arrangements.
Designed with gentle decorative details that require careful handling and supported storage to maintain shape.
Single-item festive ornament designed to add a specific decorative detail to Christmas home displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Comes with 1x Christmas Decoration
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof

The Premier Decorations Traditional Wooden Nutcracker Figure brings classic, festive charm to your seasonal décor. Standing proudly, this decorative figure is expertly crafted from high-quality wood and features the timeless design of a traditional soldier, making it an ideal centrepiece for your mantel, shelf, or festive table display.
This elegant nutcracker is not merely an ornament; it is a functional piece of heritage, complete with a built-in lever tool designed for cracking nuts in the traditional manner. Its sturdy wooden construction ensures durability, allowing it to be displayed year after year as part of your cherished holiday traditions. The intricate detailing on the uniform and the classic soldier posture capture the spirit of the season.
Perfect for creating a warm, nostalgic atmosphere in your home, this nutcracker also makes for a thoughtful and decorative gift. Its substantial 30cm height gives it a commanding presence without being overwhelming, fitting beautifully into a variety of display settings from the hearth to a console table. Embrace the classic festive aesthetic with this beautifully crafted wooden figure.

Its clear backing allows the illuminated elements to stand out, giving the effect associated with neon signs for wall displays while retaining a seasonal format. Use it as a wall decoration above a console, as part of christmas wall decorations indoor, or incorporate it among christmas hanging decorations for a layered festive scheme.
The design works well in commercial interiors too. Add it to a shop window, café, salon, office reception or retail display to create an inviting atmosphere. For parties and gatherings, it makes an eye catching background for photos and social content, while christmas light up wall decorations can give plain spaces a more celebratory feel. Bring a little character to your festive décor with this 40cm Gromit Infinity Light, a cheerful illuminated decoration that adds a warm, eye-catching glow to seasonal spaces. Shaped like the much-loved Gromit character, the freestanding design combines his familiar floppy ears, expressive face and sturdy paws with a striking infinity-style lighting effect. Rows of natural white LEDs appear to stretch into the background, creating a sense of depth and sparkle when switched on. The bold outline and distinctive detailing make it just as appealing when unlit, while the illuminated finish helps create a cosy atmosphere during darker winter evenings. Measuring approximately 40cm in height, it makes a charming feature for a sideboard, shelf, mantelpiece or festive arrangement. A 3m lead wire offers extra flexibility when positioning your decoration, and the on/off switch makes it simple to control the lighting whenever you wish. Ideal for adding personality to Christmas gatherings, winter decorating and themed gift arrangements, this infinity light brings an instantly recognisable touch of Gromit charm to your home.
Add a touch of festive personality to your home with a 40cm Gromit Infinity Light, featuring the familiar floppy ears, expressive face and distinctive character outline for a charming seasonal focal point.
The infinity-style lighting effect creates an illusion of depth through repeated points of light, with natural white LEDs bringing a warm-looking glow to your Christmas décor during darker evenings.
Standing approximately 40cm tall, this illuminated character decoration makes an eye-catching addition to a mantelpiece, sideboard, shelf or festive arrangement without needing an elaborate setup.
A generous 3m lead wire offers extra flexibility when finding a suitable spot for your festive light, while the convenient on/off switch allows straightforward control whenever you want to enjoy the glow.
